statement: Broadcom's AI revenue rests on six key customers including Google, OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta, with Anthropic described as on track to overtake Google as its largest custom AI chip customer in 2027.
why: A demand base of six accounts, some of them frontier labs whose growth Broadcom is helping finance, makes the outlook sensitive to a single customer changing plans.

impact.mechanism: Concentration in a handful of frontier labs and hyperscalers means one cancelled or deferred program would swing accelerator orders sharply, raising the variance around both custom silicon and merchant GPU demand.

evidence.excerpt: Six key customers are cited as driving this demand, including Google, OpenAI, Anthropic, and Meta

confidence.basis: Secondary paraphrase of call commentary from one outlet.
